title: Running Commentary on Torah 34 — V'Atem Tihyu Li Mamleches Kohanim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 34 — ואתם תהיו לי ממלכת כהנים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening pasuk**: **"V'atem tihyu li mamleches kohanim v'goy kadosh, eileh ha'devarim asher t'daber el b'nei Yisrael"** (Shemos 19:6). Decoded at end: **mamleches kohanim = ahavah kedoshah; goy kadosh = nekudah + vav (kodesh+lev)**; means = **eileh ha'devarim asher t'daber** (= Moshe, nekudah kellalis).

intermediate.en: **"V'atem tihyu li mamleches kohanim v'goy kadosh..."** (Shem 19:6). Decoded: **mamleches kohanim**=ahavah kedoshah; **goy kadosh**=nekudah+vav; **eileh ha'devarim asher t'daber**=Moshe=nekudah kellalis.
intermediate.he: **"ואתם תהיו לי ממלכת כהנים וגוי קדוש..."** (שמ' יט, ו). פענוח: **ממלכת כהנים**=אהבה קדושה; **גוי קדוש**=נקודה+וי"ו; **אלה הדברים אשר תדבר**=משה=נקודה כללית.

beginner.en: **"א. **'Cherpah shavrah libi'** (Tehillim 69:21) — **charafos u'bizyonos break the lev**. The tikkun: **bind his lev to the **nekudah** pertinent to his lev at this moment** — via this, the cherpah settling on his lev is nullified."**

intermediate.en: **α. Cherpah breaks lev** (Teh 69:21). Tikkun: bind lev to **nekudah** of this moment → nullifies cherpah.
intermediate.he: **α. חרפה שוברת לב** (תה' סט, כא). תיקון: קישור לב ל**נקודה** של הרגע → ביטול חרפה.

beginner.en: **"ב. Klal: **rulership is in the tzaddik's hand** — **'tzaddik moshel'** (Shmuel II 23:3; Moed Katan 16b: **'mi moshel bi — tzaddik'**). **'V'Yosef hu ha'shalit'** (Bereshis 42:6). He = **shoresh kelalus nishmos Yisrael**, and they are his **anafim** receiving from him. Ikkar ha'memshalah = to **illuminate + awaken their hearts** to avodas Hashem — **'shma Hashem kol Yehudah v'el amo teviyenu'** (Devarim 33:7)."**

intermediate.en: **β. Tzaddik moshel** (II Shm 23:3; MK 16b "mi moshel bi — tzaddik"; Ber 42:6 "Yosef ha'shalit"). Tzaddik=shoresh kelalus neshamos; anafim receive. Rulership=illuminate+awaken lev to avodah (Dev 33:7).
intermediate.he: **ב. צדיק מושל** (ש"ב כג, ג; מו"ק טז: "מי מושל בי — צדיק"; בר' מב, ו "יוסף השליט"). צדיק=שורש כלליות נשמות; ענפים מקבלים. ממשלה=להאיר+לעורר לב לעבודה (דב' לג, ז).

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. ש"ב כג, ג; מו"ק טז:; בר' מב, ו; דב' לג, ז.

beginner.en: **"ג. This bechina ('Yosef hu ha'shalit') = bechina of **melupum** (the vowel shuruk/melupum). **Bris-merkavah for yesod**: Havayah with **melupum** (Tikkun 70; Sha'arei Tziyon). **Melupum = osiyos 'malei pum'** (full mouth) — the **kli ha'shefa (pi of the tzaddik) is full of Elokus**. Hence tefilah is needed (though Hashem knows thoughts) — because **kisufim need to emerge through the mouth**; the pi ha'tzaddik is **malei pum**."**

intermediate.en: **γ. "Yosef ha'shalit"=melupum** (Tikkun 70; Sha'arei Tziyon — bris merkavah, Havayah+melupum). **Melupum**="malei pum"=kli ha'shefa/pi ha'tzaddik full of Elokus. Hence tefilah emerges via mouth.
intermediate.he: **ג. "יוסף השליט"=מלאפום** (תיקון ע; שערי ציון — ברית מרכבה, הויה+מלאפום). **מלאפום**="מלא פום"=כלי השפע/פה הצדיק מלא אלוקות. לכן תפילה דרך הפה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. תיקון ע; שערי ציון.

beginner.en: **"ד. Every Jew has bechina of **'tzaddik moshel' = malei pum** — **'v'amcha Yisrael kulam tzaddikim'** (Yeshayahu 60:21); **'Yisrael memshelosav'** (Tehillim 114:2) — 'mi moshel bi — tzaddik.' Each Jew has a **precious thing = bechina of nekudah** that his fellow doesn't have — as in Abaye + Abba Umna (Ta'anis 21b — 'you cannot do like Abba Umna'). This personal bechina that he has above his fellow = **nekudah**."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Each Jew=tzaddik moshel=malei pum** (Yesh 60:21; Teh 114:2). Each has unique **nekudah** (Abaye+Abba Umna, Ta'an 21b).
intermediate.he: **ד. כל יהודי=צדיק מושל=מלא פום** (יש' ס, כא; תה' קיד, ב). לכל אחד **נקודה** ייחודית (אביי+אבא אומנא, תענ' כא:).

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. יש' ס, כא; תה' קיד, ב; תענ' כא:.

beginner.en: **"ה. Melupum = **nekudah + vav**. Yosef is drawn from **chochmah + binah** (Bereshis 41:39 **'achrei hodia Elokim oscha es kol zos, ein navon v'chacham kamocha'** = chochmah+binah). **Chochmah=nekudah=yud=ma'ayan**. **Binah=nachal ha'nimshach min ha'ma'ayan**; on account of **hamshachah** is called **vav** = **nachal drawn from yud-ma'ayan**."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Melupum=nekudah+vav**. Yosef from chochmah+binah (Ber 41:39 "navon v'chacham"). **Chochmah=nekudah=yud=ma'ayan; binah=nachal=vav** drawn from yud.
intermediate.he: **ה. מלאפום=נקודה+וי"ו**. יוסף מחכמה+בינה (בר' מא, לט "נבון וחכם"). **חכמה=נקודה=יוד=מעיין; בינה=נחל=וי"ו** הנמשך מיוד.

beginner.en: **"ו. Melupum = **klal + prat**. **10 Dibros + 2 Luchos = yud + vav (melupum)** — luchos = **6 × 6** (Bava Basra 14a). **Torah + Olam = yud + vav**: Torah=yud (**'reishis chochmah,'** Tehillim 111:10); Olam=vav (created in **6 days**). **Tzaddik + Yisrael = yud + vav**: tzaddik=yud (**'tzaddikim nirmazim b'yud,'** i.e. the **nekudah**); Yisrael=vav."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Melupum=klal+prat**: 10 Dibros+luchos=yud+vav (6×6, BB 14a). Torah+Olam=yud+vav ("reishis chochmah," Teh 111:10; 6 days). Tzaddik+Yisrael=yud+vav.
intermediate.he: **ו. מלאפום=כלל+פרט**: עשרת הדברות+לוחות=יוד+וי"ו (6×6, ב"ב יד). תורה+עולם=יוד+וי"ו ("ראשית חכמה", תה' קיא, י; ו' ימים). צדיק+ישראל=יוד+וי"ו.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. ב"ב יד; תה' קיא, י.

beginner.en: **"ז. When the **lev (vav/luchos) is sunk in **ahavos ra'os** = charafos u'bizyonos = **arlas lev** (Devarim 10:16) — it's bechina of **shivrei luchos**. **Cherpah = arlah** — **'lo nuchal laseis es achoseinu l'ish asher lo arlah, ki cherpah hi lanu'** (Bereshis 34:14). It's a **fallen/shattered ahavah**, for the **yetzer ha'ra and klipos are made from shviras ha'kelim** (Etz Chayim, Hechal ha'Nekudim)."**

intermediate.en: **η. Lev sunk in ahavos ra'os/charafos=arlas lev** (Dev 10:16)=shivrei luchos. Cherpah=arlah (Ber 34:14); yetzer hara+klipos from shviras ha'kelim (Etz Chayim).
intermediate.he: **ז. לב שקוע באהבות רעות/חרפות=ערלת לב** (דב' י, טז)=שברי לוחות. חרפה=ערלה (בר' לד, יד); יצה"ר+קליפות משבירת הכלים (עץ חיים).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. דב' י, טז; בר' לד, יד; עץ חיים.

beginner.en: **"ח. Each must **daber beino l'bein kono** — so the **nekudah** shines, bechina of **'pi yedaber chochmos'** (Tehillim 49:4), to the **vav** which is **'v'hagus libi tevunos'** (ibid.). Thereby **arlas ha'lev**/charafos/ahavos ra'os is nullified. Must also **speak with one's fellow b'yiras shamayim** — receive arousal in his lev from **the nekudah his fellow has above him** — **'u'm'kabelin dein min dein'** (Isaiah, Zohar). The friend's special nekudah (above yours) is **da'as-level** for you."**

intermediate.en: **θ. Daber beino l'bein kono** → nekudah shines ("pi yedaber chochmos... v'hagus libi tevunos," Teh 49:4). Also daber b'yiras shamayim with fellow → receive from his higher nekudah ("u'm'kabelin dein min dein").
intermediate.he: **ח. דיבור בינו לבין קונו** → נקודה מאירה ("פי ידבר חכמות... והגות ליבי תבונות", תה' מט, ד). גם דיבור ביר"ש עם חבר → קבלה מנקודתו הגבוהה ("ומקבלין דין מן דין").

beginner.en: **"All these **nekudos** — the **'pi yedaber chochmos'** nekudah and the **fellow's higher nekudah** — are **anafim to the tzaddik**, who is the **nekudah kellalis of all Israel**. All must first receive from the tzaddik, then **'u'm'kabelin dein min dein'**; each receives **minah u'v'eha** (from her and within her). Via these 3 bechinos (self-nekudah, fellow's, tzaddik's) — **charafos/arlas lev/ahavos ra'os** are nullified. **'Al kol pesha'im t'chaseh ahavah'** (Mishlei 10:12) — there dwells **ahavah kedoshah**."**

intermediate.en: All nekudos=**anafim to tzaddik=nekudah kellalis**. Chain: tzaddik → dein min dein → each minah u'v'eha. 3 bechinos → nullify arlas lev → **"al kol pesha'im t'chaseh ahavah"** (Mishlei 10:12).
intermediate.he: כל הנקודות=**ענפים לצדיק=נקודה כללית**. שרשרת: צדיק → דין מן דין → כל אחד מינה ובה. ג' בחינות → ביטול ערלת לב → **"על כל פשעים תכסה אהבה"** (מש' י, יב).

beginner.en: **"Peirush the pasuk**: **'V'atem tihyu li mamleches kohanim'** = **ahavah kedoshah** (kohanim = chesed/ahavah). **'V'goy kadosh'** = **kadosh=nekudah + vav=lev**. How reach ahavah kedoshah + kadosh-vav? Via **'eileh ha'devarim asher t'daber el b'nei Yisrael'** — **Moshe = nekudah kellalis of nishmos Yisrael**; all must first **receive from the klal-nekudah (Moshe)**, then each **illuminates his fellow from his own nekudah**, and each receives from his own."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush pasuk**: **Mamleches kohanim**=ahavah kedoshah (kohanim=chesed); **goy kadosh**=nekudah+vav=lev. Via **"eileh ha'devarim asher t'daber"**=Moshe=nekudah kellalis → klal→each→self.
intermediate.he: **פירוש הפסוק**: **ממלכת כהנים**=אהבה קדושה; **גוי קדוש**=נקודה+וי"ו=לב. דרך **"אלה הדברים אשר תדבר"**=משה=נקודה כללית → כלל→כל→עצמי.
